answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims at presenting salient points of a text, concisely and fluently.

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance of our models by automatic evaluation using ROUGE metric.

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we also perform human evaluation to confirm the performance of our three (3) top models by ROUGE. We design the following Amazon MTurk experiment: we randomly select 50 samples from the DUC 2004 and MULTINEWS and ask the human testers (3 per sample) to rank between outputs.
answer_4.guideline: The testers were required to scale (1 -5, with 5 being of superior quality to 1) the system's output on informativeness (how well does it cover the information in the reference summary?), fluency (how well does the information in the systems summary flow?) and nonredundancy (how well are information not being repeated?).
